jobs.name: Megalodon
jobs.prompt: Using the attached image only as a STYLE reference (chunky stylized low-poly 3D, flat-shaded facets, bold colors), paint a terrifying world boss for a Roblox underwater game: a colossal prehistoric MEGALODON shark looming out of the dark open ocean, dwarfing a few tiny stylized player fish in the foreground for scale. Battle-scarred slate-grey hide with pale belly, rows of huge jagged teeth in a half-open mouth, small cold glowing eyes, torn fins, old harpoons stuck in its side. Deep navy water with sunbeams fading into the abyss, a sense of dread. Menacing, not cute. No text, no watermark.
